title: Turkish Causative Voice (-dir / -tir / -t)
summary: Making verbs causative ('to make someone do something').
explanation: Attach causative suffixes ('-dir/-tır/-t/-iz') to verb stems to indicate causing or having someone perform an action (e.g., okuttu = made read).

example_translations.ex_trcau_1: The teacher made the student read the book.

common_error_explanations.err_trcau_1: Use causative suffixes to indicate causing someone else to act.
